title: Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit — Network Size and Preferred Pharmacy Schedule
content:
The Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit is offered on six networks a plan sponsor may elect. This schedule sets, for each network, the approximate number of contracted retail pharmacies and whether the network has a preferred-pharmacy subset, together with the amount by which a member's cost share for formulary tiers 1, 2 and 3 is lowered at a preferred pharmacy for each 30-day supply.

| | Northbridge Performance Network | Northbridge Essential Network | Northbridge National Network | Northbridge Preferred Savings Network | Northbridge Retail90 Network | Northbridge Open Choice Network |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Approximate contracted retail pharmacies | 24000 | 38000 | 61000 | 63000 | 63000 | 66000 |
| Preferred-pharmacy subset | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | No |
| Tier 1 reduction at a preferred pharmacy, per 30-day supply | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 5.00 USD | 5.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Tier 2 reduction at a preferred pharmacy, per 30-day supply | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 10.00 USD | 10.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Tier 3 reduction at a preferred pharmacy, per 30-day supply | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 10.00 USD | 10.00 USD | 0.00 USD |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The pharmacy count is an approximate figure, informational only, and is the number quoted to members.
2. A preferred-pharmacy subset exists only on the Northbridge Preferred Savings Network and the Northbridge Retail90 Network; on the other four networks every reduction figure is 0.00 USD.
3. Each reduction is an amount in USD per 30-day supply, and a reduced tier 1 cost share is never below 0.00 USD.

## Reading the schedule

- **Which networks carry a preferred reduction for tier 2?** The Northbridge Preferred Savings Network and the Northbridge Retail90 Network, each at 10.00 USD per 30-day supply.
- **Is the tier 1 reduction the same as the tier 2 reduction on those networks?** No. Tier 1 is reduced by 5.00 USD and tiers 2 and 3 by 10.00 USD per 30-day supply.
- **What pharmacy count is quoted to a member on the Northbridge National Network?** About 61000 contracted retail pharmacies.
